intro.what: Anthropic's terminal coding agent — the richest extension surface of the four harnesses
intro.trust: Ask-to-approve tool permissions + unoverridable managed settings; npm plugin sources never run scripts

cards.what: Folders of SKILL.md instructions the model auto-loads when relevant
cards.format: SKILL.md + YAML frontmatter (open Agent Skills spec)
cards.autoupdate: No — unversioned file drop, no update mechanism; only plugins auto-update
cards.why: Agent Skills spec native; Claude extras via overlay

cards.what: Markdown files that become /slash-command prompts; absorbed by skills
cards.autoupdate: No — legacy unversioned drop; no update path; superseded by skills
cards.why: same frontmatter as skills; drop works as-is
emission: prefer: emit as skill (commands merged in)

cards.what: Markdown-defined helper agents with their own prompt & tool scope
cards.autoupdate: No — unversioned file drop; plugin-bundled agents update with the plugin
cards.why: canonical shape; other harnesses must translate

cards.what: Scripts fired automatically on 30 lifecycle events; can block tools
cards.format: hooks JSON map: Event → matcher → handler (5 types)
cards.autoupdate: No — unversioned settings edits; plugin hooks ride plugin updates
cards.why: native hooks JSON; only the merge scope varies

cards.what: Bundles of skills, agents, hooks and MCP installed from marketplaces
cards.autoupdate: Yes — opt-in per marketplace (v2.0.70, 2025-12-15); the only auto-updater
emission: version: manifest → marketplace entry → git sha

cards.what: External tool servers (stdio or http) wired in via CLI or JSON
cards.autoupdate: No — no update mechanism; manual re-add; entries replace, never merge
cards.why: mcpServers entry drops in as-is (CLI or JSON)

cards.what: Language servers bundled in plugins to add code-aware tools
cards.where: plugin root only: .lsp.json or plugin.json lspServers
cards.manage: none — bundle in plugin; rides plugin install
cards.autoupdate: Rides parent plugin: no own path; plugin auto-update covers it
cards.why: bare .lsp.json → must wrap in a plugin

cards.what: Custom tools written as in-process MCP servers in Agent SDK code
cards.where: code only — Agent SDK customTools; no filesystem path
cards.format: SDK code: in-process MCP server (customTools API)
cards.manage: Agent SDK customTools; no CLI, no file drop
cards.autoupdate: No — lives in host app code; there is no artifact to update
cards.why: SDK code surface; nothing installable to drop
emission: no manifest, no version, nothing to pin

cards.what: Custom bottom-bar status script fed session JSON on stdin
cards.where: settings key statusLine → any script path (all scopes)
cards.autoupdate: Rides parent — settings points at a script; replacing script updates it
cards.why: script + one settings key; no format change
emission: input: JSON session state on stdin

cards.what: Permission rules and modes deciding which tool runs need approval
cards.autoupdate: Not an artifact — settings state; no update channel; managed keys admin-only
cards.why: record declares required perms → allow-rule overlay
